hero.label: Made for Unbound
hero.headline: I want to help Unbound own enterprise AI security from the ground up.
hero.subheadline: The problem Unbound is solving is urgent and real: enterprises are already using AI tools whether security teams approve or not, and sensitive data is leaking as a result. I want to be the person who builds the pipeline that gets Unbound in front of the CISOs and IT leaders who need this product before their next breach. Coming from a BDR role at an AI company and a B2B growth internship, I know what it takes to turn a compelling technical story into qualified revenue.

whyCompany.title: Enterprise AI governance is the defining security problem of this decade
whyCompany.body: Shadow AI usage inside enterprises is accelerating faster than any compliance or security framework can keep up with. Unbound sits at exactly the right intersection of timing and necessity, offering a solution that lets companies say yes to AI productivity without gambling on data exposure. That is a genuinely hard problem to solve and an even harder one to sell, which is what makes the growth challenge so interesting.

whyCompany.title: Founding team hire means the playbook is still being written
whyCompany.body: Joining as a founding growth engineer means there are no inherited scripts to follow and no legacy processes to work around. Every outreach sequence, every ICP refinement, and every channel experiment will actually matter and will leave a mark on how Unbound grows. For someone early in their career, there is no better environment to learn fast and build something that lasts.

whyCompany.title: I have done exactly this kind of zero-to-one B2B pipeline work before
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I built cold outreach from scratch using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences and helped bring in 15 to 20 paying clients as a 19-year-old. At NextAfter I worked inside a B2B consultancy learning how digital growth strategy gets packaged and sold to sophisticated buyers. Unbound needs someone who can identify the right enterprise contacts, build sequences that cut through the noise, and iterate quickly on what converts.

quote: Most people my age are applying to rotational programs. I want to be the person who figures out how Unbound cracks the enterprise market before anyone else does.
